segment_summary: এই চক্ষুদানের মাধ্যমে মাটি আর দেবীর মধ্যেকার সীমারেখা মুছে যায়, যেখানে ভক্তিই শিল্পের চূড়ান্ত রূপান্তর ঘটায়।

segment_enrichment.angle: Shifting perspective entirely into the eye itself: describing it not as seeing the world, but reflecting an internalized, timeless myth.
segment_enrichment.story_option: The internal struggle between two artists: one seeking perfect realism and another seeking pure, abstract transcendence in the final touch (Setting: Adjacent to the main deity form; Desire: Definitive artistic success; Obstacle: Competing aesthetic philosophies; Turn: The clash resolves not in synthesis, but through a sudden, overwhelming shared exhaustion).
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Focusing less on Durga, and more on the preparatory process itself—how societal belief constructs the vessel capable of housing the Myth.
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The granular texture of the pigment dust under fingernails, dry against the slickness of residual clay.
segment_enrichment.research_question: Are there specific ancient Bengali ritualistic phrases used to denote the transition from inert material to a living spiritual icon during *chokkhudan*?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: A recursive structure: The act of painting an eye calls forth the memory of previous divine manifestations, each iteration being a reflection.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: Unlike preceding chapters focused on external cycles and physical labor, this chapter centers entirely on a singular, intensely concentrated act of imbuing passive matter with active consciousness.
